source.statement:
SELECT
    ORDER_NUMBER,
    STORE_REGION,
    PRODUCT_FAMILY,
    PRICE,
    QUANTITY
FROM
    EXAMPLES.PLUGS_ELECTRONICS.PLUGS_ELECTRONICS_HANDS_ON_LAB_DATA
WHERE
    STORE_REGION = {{system::CurrentUserAttributeText::Store_Region}}

-- @sigma-rls: none — public product dimension, no row security required
SELECT
    PRODUCT_FAMILY,
    PRODUCT_TYPE
FROM
    EXAMPLES.PLUGS_ELECTRONICS.PRODUCTS

-- @sigma-rls: external — sourced from secured view V_REGION_SALES which applies RLS upstream
SELECT
    STORE_REGION,
    SUM(REVENUE) AS total_revenue
FROM
    EXAMPLES.PLUGS_ELECTRONICS.V_REGION_SALES
GROUP BY 1

SELECT 'NA' AS region
UNION ALL SELECT 'EMEA'
UNION ALL SELECT 'APAC'
